UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated HardWorkAI user account profile used to bind MCP connectors.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the HardWorkAI account.

displayName.description: Display name of the HardWorkAI user.

photoURL.description: Optional HTTPS avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was last updated.

McpConnection.title: McpConnection
McpConnection.description: Configured MCP connector bound to the authenticated HardWorkAI user account.

connectorId.description: Catalog or custom identifier of the MCP connector.

name.description: Display name of the MCP connector.

endpoint.description: HTTPS MCP server endpoint URL or sanitized stdio command.

approvedAppsOnly.description: Whether connector requires approved workspace apps.

custom.description: Whether the connector was added manually via Adicionar outro MCP.

ownerUid.description: HardWorkAI user UID bound to this MCP connection.

accountEmail.description: HardWorkAI account email bound to this MCP connection.

everyoneInOrg.description: Whether all organization members can access this MCP connector.

toolsSelection.description: Whether all connector tools or only picked tools are enabled.

connected.description: Connection state of the MCP connector.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the connector was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the connector was last updated.

/users/{userId}/mcpConnections/{connecti.description: MCP connector configurations linked to the authenticated HardWorkAI account.
